description: Multistorey Car Parking Space Availability DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Multi storey Car Parking Space Availability. Dublin City Council's 'Live Parking Spaces' service gathers information from car parks around Dublin to show users parking space availability in key car parks in the central Dublin area. Updated every 5 mins. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Transport and Infrastructure, multi-story-car-parks, parking, traffic, traffic-management. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, XLS, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
